subject: English
stimulus: (a) I am looking for Raihan. If I had seen him, ⎯⎯. (b) Shila seemed upset. She talked as if ⎯⎯. (c) Yesterday we were at our office. Scarcely had we finished our duty ⎯⎯. (d) We are not free from danger. Danger often comes where ⎯⎯. (e) Restless life is risky. We have to take rest ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: (a) If I had seen him, I would have informed him about the fact. (b) She talked as if she had lost everything. (c) Scarcely had we finished our duty when we left our office. (d) Danger often comes where danger is feared. (e) We have to take rest so that we may save our life from risk.
